verdict.rationale: An email client could plausibly offer a public API with UI parity, so this axis applies. The evidence documents no public Shortwave API: probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs all return 404. The MCP material describes Shortwave acting as a client to other apps' servers, and Gmail API usage and Zapier/Tasklet connections are host-platform or adjacent integrations, not programmatic access to Shortwave's own UI features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
